tool_args.rationale: The maximum pilot s_grad is 2.44, above the 2.36 gray-zone gate and near the stated avalanche threshold. A targeted high-gradient probe is needed to identify whether and where the additional sink activates.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot enters the uncertified supercritical gray zone, where the threshold-avalanche term is not identifiable from these observations alone.
The targeted high-gradient probe directly tests the unresolved threshold at lower cost.
The verified siphon mechanism and monotone-concave pilot are more directly relevant; high-gradient measurements can discriminate the avalanche contribution.
